params.body:
Signal's blurb promises "The whole archive", but its `archive_days` was 90. Through the agent door, a Signal member was refused trends older than that with "not in your Signal plan; Signal has it".

Signal now opens all of it (`archive_days: null`), like Decode and Intelligence. Explore keeps its 30 days.

The site's own fallback offer gets the same value in gentells-site (gate fixes PR). Tests: 961 passing.
params.title: Plans: Signal opens the whole archive
